titles.title: Environmental Health Restoration Act of 2026
Environmental Health Restoration Act of 2026

To restore and strengthen the obligation of the Environmental Protection Agency to protect human health and the environment, to halt unlawful deregulatory actions, to require enforcement of the Clean Air Act, and for other purposes.
